definitions.explanation: The middle of several layers, in the air, the sea, the earth, or a building's floors.
Of a building: of medium height, in Japan roughly three to five stories.
The middle class or middle level of a society or organization.

notes:
Part of a three-way set: ⟦{上層|じょうそう}→上層：24077_jousou⟧ (upper), {中層|ちゅうそう} (middle), ⟦{下層|かそう}→下層：11372_kasou⟧ (lower). For buildings the set is ⟦{低層|ていそう}→低層：21924_teisou⟧, {中層|ちゅうそう}, ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧, ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}→超高層：26197_choukousou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中層|ちゅうそう}⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧・{中層|ちゅうそう}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧: a mid-rise condominium or housing
- {中層|ちゅうそう}{雲|うん}: mid-level clouds (meteorology)
- {中層|ちゅうそう}⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧: the middle floors of a building
